<MethodEndpoint
  method={'post'}
  path={'/v1/onboardings/{id}/agreements'}
  context={'endpoint'}
></MethodEndpoint>

Links one published version to the onboarding as pending, out of band of any step the customer is walking, and notifies the workflow's notify webhook with `onboarding.agreement_pending`. Idempotent: a pair already linked reports `created: false` and sends nothing, which is why the response is `200` rather than `201`.
